title: Dengue prevention measures in all Mandaue schools stepped up

blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Department of Education (DepEd)-Mandaue is stepping up dengue prevention measures across public schools following the reported three deaths and and 70 dengue cases among learners this year. DepEd-Mandaue intensified efforts to protect learners include campus-wide clean-up drives, misting operations, installation of medicated mosquito nets and closer coordination with parents and health authorities. Atty. Marinel Oro, legal officer of DepEd-Mandaue, said the dengue cases spiked this month, with 36 cases recorded. Most were elementary students.
